metadata.title: Hellosis
metadata.description: Discover groups, events and places around you.

home.heading: Meet women who share your world
home.subheading: Join interest-based groups, chat in trusted circles, attend events and discover community-approved places — all in a safe space built for real connections.
home.trustDetail: Every member is verified for your safety

groups.title: Interest groups
groups.description: Discover like-minded women and join communities around hobbies, causes and your city.

chats.title: Private & group chats
chats.description: Talk securely with members through safe, moderated conversations.

events.title: Real events
events.description: Meet in person at community events designed around shared interests.

places.title: Trusted places
places.description: Find places recommended and reviewed by women you trust.

safety.title: Safety first, always
safety.description: Identity verification, community moderation and privacy controls keep every conversation secure.

join.title: Your community is waiting
join.description: Create your profile, pick your interests and start connecting.

home.footer: Made with care for women everywhere.
